full.description: This image is a low-power photomicrograph of a brain section. The histological view shows areas of parenchymal loss, tissue softening, and structural disruption. These findings are characteristic of encephalomalasia resulting from previous ischemic injury or infarction. The pale, cavitated areas represent the resorption of necrotic brain tissue by macrophages.

random.description: This is a low-power photomicrograph of a lymph node or similar lymphoid organ. The tissue section shows extensive architectural changes characterized by large pale areas and peripheral lymphoid tissue. The findings are indicative of a significant pathological process involving the organ's structure. Further high-magnification examination is necessary to confirm the specific diagnosis.
